scope: Follow-on bounded static candidate trace and disposable ordering experiments. No behavior change or native parity is claimed.

nativeStatic.method: Read-only Ghidra 12.1.4 import with automatic analysis disabled; disassemble and decompile the three call targets observed in candidate 0x14032c400.
observations: Candidate 0x14032e330 uses a four-byte FNV-style lookup for an integer key. Its decompilation walks records, searches three integer slots for a key and appends the following two cyclic slots as a pair.
Candidate 0x14032c400 calls 0x14032edf0 for both values of a returned pair and conditionally calls 0x14032dae0; the data structures and geometry semantics are not established.

applicationExperiments.observation: None of these local ordering variants matches all native outputs. No variant was applied to production.
